canada.title: Pedestrian who was run over twice succumbs to injuries
canada.summary: At approximately 5:40 a.m. Monday morning, investigators received a report of a serious injury collision involving a pedestrian and a vehicle at 135 Martindale Blvd. in northeast Calgary, said Traffic Unit Staff Sgt. Andy Woodward.

canada.summary: A 35-year-old man has been charged with stealing several vehicles from across Winnipeg, including many from dealerships and autobody shops.

canada.summary: Prime Minister Mark Carney said on Monday that he's opening to 'moving beyond' or abolishing the Indian Act.

canada.title: Supporters rally as historic youth-led climate trial begins in Vancouver
canada.summary: Crowds of supporters gathered outside the Federal Court building in Vancouver on Monday in solidarity with plaintiffs in Canada's first youth-led climate trial.

canada.title: Moncton council asks for short-term rental rules
canada.summary: Moncton councillors have asked city staff to draft a bylaw regulating short-term rentals like Airbnb and Vrbo.

canada.title: 'A matter of life and death': Arson suspected at home where murder trial witness staying
canada.summary: One week before the Crown’s key witness was scheduled to testify at her former boyfriend’s second-degree murder trial in Calgary, police say someone set fire to the home where she was staying, CBC News can now report.

canada.title: Nurses warn of escalating risks as Brandon ER grapples with staffing shortages
canada.summary: The Manitoba Nurses Union warns chronic staffing shortages and mounting security risks are pushing emergency room staff to their limits while patients face long wait times.

canada.title: Uniqlo to move into old Nordstrom building in downtown Vancouver
canada.summary: Since Nordstrom closed, many have speculated as to what storefront could fill the space and last year it was announced that it would be divided into four units.

canada.title: 'Time to abolish the Indian Act,' Manitoba premier tells PM in historic meeting with chiefs
canada.summary: Manitoba Premier Wab Kinew is calling on the federal government to abolish the Indian Act.

canada.title: Debt levels, limits on 'affordability measures,' loom large as House of Assembly returns
canada.summary: The House of Assembly started back for a fall session Monday, with the Government of Newfoundland and Labrador being challenged to do more on affordability. The government says its limited in its response by the province's debt concern.

canada.title: Q&A | N.W.T. author honours late grandfather Richard Lafferty in first book
canada.summary: Treiva Plamondon’s grandfather, legendary Métis fiddler Richard Lafferty, died five years ago. Plamondon says writing ‘Papa’s Magic Fiddle’ became a way to honour her beloved Papa, and move through the grief of losing him.

canada.title: Quebec Liberal Party challenge judicial recount results, rejected ballots, in Vachon after 3-vote loss
canada.summary: The Quebec Liberal Party candidate who lost to the Parti Québécois in the riding of Vachon after a recount said her party is launching a legal challenge against the results.

canada.title: Protest outside First Nations–First Ministers Meeting decry closed doors and ‘economic coercion’
canada.summary: A protest was held outside the First Nations-First Ministers Meeting in Ottawa over the lack of participation in the event.

canada.title: Brampton man arrested, charged in connection with fatal stabbing in Mississauga
canada.summary: A 35-year-old Brampton man has been arrested and charged in the stabbing death of a 47-year-old Bradford, Ont., man in Mississauga over the weekend.

canada.title: CityVote 2026: Live election results from across the GTA municipal elections
canada.summary: Municipal elections are happening across Ontario today with exciting races cross the Greater Toronto Area (GTA). You can find all the results here as they are released.

canada.title: N.B. students unsure about federal bill to ban social media for youth under 16
canada.summary: Two students, one at Fredericton High School and one at Mount Allison University, agree that social media platforms are flawed, but disagree that a proposed solution to ban youth under 16 is the way to go.

canada.title: Ex-N.S. PC interim leader endorses another former Tory for Liberal leadership
canada.summary: A former interim leader of Nova Scotia's Progressive Conservatives has endorsed her former PC cabinet colleague to become the new provincial Liberal leader.

canada.title: Northerners among youth taking climate fight to federal court
canada.summary: Kira Young of Yellowknife and Leandrea Reeves of Whitehorse are among 15 young plaintiffs who've filed a lawsuit against the federal government over climate change. The trial is scheduled to begin Monday, where they'll argue the trajectory of greenhouse gas emissions causes harm and violates their rights.
